command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'host='; hostname
printf 'user='; id -un
printf '%s\n' '--- services ---'
for u in omega-local-effect-adapter.service omega-chatgpt-mcp.service frankenstein-local-bridge.service; do printf '%s=' "$u"; systemctl --user is-active "$u" || true; systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --no-pager | tr '\n' ' '; printf '\n'; done
printf '%s\n' '--- installed hashes ---'
sha256sum "$HOME/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp/omega_chatgpt_mcp_fallback.py" "$HOME/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp/omega_local_effect_adapter.py" "$HOME/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp/omega_grid_relay.py" "$HOME/.claude/star/local_bridge_daemon.py"
printf '%s\n' '--- health ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, socket, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
cfg={}
for line in Path.home().joinpath('.config/omega/omega-mcp.env').read_text().splitlines():
    if line and not line.lstrip().startswith('#') and '=' in line:
        k,v=line.split('=',1); cfg[k]=v
port=cfg.get('OMEGA_MCP_PORT','8789')
with urllib.request.urlopen(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health', timeout=3) as r:
    h=json.loads(r.read().decode())
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM); s.settimeout(3); s.connect(cfg['OMEGA_LOCAL_EFFECT_SOCKET'])
req={'schema':'OMEGA_LOCAL_EFFECT/v1','token':cfg['OMEGA_LOCAL_EFFECT_TOKEN'],'kind':'health'}
s.sendall(json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode()+b'\n')
raw=s.recv(65536).split(b'\n',1)[0]; s.close(); local=json.loads(raw.decode())
print(json.dumps({'mcp_ok':h.get('ok'),'mcp_machine_id':h.get('machine_id'),'mcp_owner':h.get('owner'),'local_ok':local.get('ok'),'local_machine_id':local.get('machine_id'),'local_owner':local.get('owner')},sort_keys=True))
assert h.get('ok') is True
assert local.get('ok') is True
assert local.get('machine_id')=='ai-core-node' and local.get('owner')=='gabriel'
PY
